title: Gravitational Waves
description: Masses that accelerate send ripples through spacetime itself, stretching and squeezing everything they cross. The strongest reach us from merging black holes, as a strain of one part in 10²¹. Unlocks the Laser Interferometer and its Test Masses.

puzzle.goal: Two bodies of masses m _ 1 and m _ 2 circle each other a distance a apart, far away at a distance r. Their changing shape sends out gravitational waves; write the strain h they make here, to order of magnitude.
puzzle.name: Quadrupole strain of a binary
puzzle.ask: Find h in units of 10⁻²¹ for two black holes of A = B = @{B} kg, a = 3.5e5 m apart, r = @{r} m away (G = 6.674e-11, c = 2.998e8).
puzzle.method: The quadrupole formula: h ≈ (2G/c⁴r)·d²Q/dt², and for a circular binary the second derivative of its quadrupole is about 2μa²ω², with ω² = G(m₁+m₂)/a³.
